This isn’t in Tokyo or Osaka…
It’s in Fukuoka! Most people come to Japan for cherry blossom season, but if you’re visiting after the peak bloom, don’t skip this park. Uminonakamichi Seaside Park has both late blooming cherry blossoms and a sea of nemophila (baby blue eyes), and honestly, I found them even prettier than the sakura. I visited on April 19 and the timing was perfect, late April to mid May is usually the best window. So if you’re booking a trip to Japan and miss cherry blossom season, come here instead! Save this spot for your spring Japan travel planning and send it to someone who needs to see Japan in baby blue bloom!
